info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Olivine Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Olivine Notebook Detail Catalog API allows users to efficiently add detailed information about Olivine Notebooks to the catalog. This operation is essential for maintaining an updated inventory and ensuring that product details are accurately represented. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that require integration with the catalog database. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their product offerings and streamline their catalog management processes.

post.summary: Create new details for an Olivine notebook
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit new details for an Olivine notebook. It is designed to facilitate the addition of supplementary information that enhances the notebook's content and usability.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details related to the olivine notebook. The payload should adhere to the defined schema, containing all necessary attributes for processing the request.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the details are returned.
